matchstick.title: Preserve stick orientation
matchstick.principle: When relocating a matchstick, keep its original orientation (vertical, horizontal, or diagonal). Changing orientation would create an illegal shape that is not a valid Roman numeral or operator.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Before moving any stick, note its orientation and ensure the destination uses the same orientation.
matchstick.example: Changing a diagonal stick from a V into a vertical stick to form an I, which is not allowed.

matchstick.title: No addition or removal of sticks
matchstick.principle: Exactly one existing stick may be moved; you cannot create a new stick or discard a stick without placing it elsewhere. The total stick count must stay constant.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When planning a move, pair every stick removal with a corresponding addition to another character.
matchstick.example: Turning '+' into '-' by removing its vertical stick and not placing that stick anywhere else.

matchstick.title: Maintain valid characters
matchstick.principle: After the move, every symbol must be a legal Roman numeral (I, V, X, L, C, D, M) or a valid operator (+, -, =). No partial or undefined shapes are allowed.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After performing the relocation, scan the whole equation and verify each character against the allowed set.
matchstick.example: Removing one diagonal from a V, leaving a single diagonal, which is not a valid Roman numeral.

matchstick.title: Verify arithmetic correctness
matchstick.principle: Convert all Roman numerals on both sides of the equation to Arabic numbers and check that the equality holds before finalising the answer.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After you have a candidate equation, perform the numeric check; if it fails, discard the move.
matchstick.example: Proposing 'XVIII = VII + VII' without checking that 18 ≠ 14.

matchstick.title: Do not break X or V
matchstick.principle: X and V consist of exactly two diagonal sticks; after moving a stick, each must still contain both diagonals, otherwise they become invalid symbols.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Never remove a diagonal from X or V unless you immediately replace it within the same character.
matchstick.example: Taking one diagonal from an X and leaving it with a single diagonal, which is not a valid numeral.

matchstick.title: Within‑numeral stick repositioning
matchstick.principle: A stick may be moved to a different position inside the same numeral, changing its shape (e.g., turning a V into an X by repositioning one diagonal). The stick’s orientation must stay the same.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When you need to alter a numeral’s value without affecting other symbols, consider repositioning a stick within that numeral.
matchstick.example: Attempting to change VII to XII by removing a diagonal from V and discarding it, instead of repositioning it inside V to form an X.

matchstick.title: Equality sign preservation
matchstick.principle: The equation must contain exactly one '=' sign after the move; you cannot remove or alter its horizontal sticks to turn it into another symbol.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Never select a stick from the '=' sign as the source unless you also replace it with an identical horizontal stick elsewhere.
matchstick.example: Removing one of the two horizontal sticks from '=', leaving a single '-' sign.

matchstick.title: Inter‑character stick transfer
matchstick.principle: A stick may be moved from one character to a different character, altering both. Ensure the source character remains a valid symbol (or is eliminated entirely) and the destination becomes a valid symbol.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a single‑stick numeral can supply a stick to create or extend another numeral or operator.
matchstick.example: Moving a vertical stick from an I to a V but leaving the source I empty, resulting in an invalid character.

matchstick.title: Answer formatting
matchstick.principle: The final response must end with a line exactly matching 'Correct version of the equation: <equation>', using uppercase letters and collapsing whitespace.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After you have the correct equation, format the answer line precisely before submitting.
matchstick.example: Writing 'Correct version of the equation: X=XI+I' (missing required spaces) which the verifier rejects.

matchstick.title: Single‑stick numeral removal allowed
matchstick.principle: A numeral that consists of a single stick (e.g., I) may be eliminated entirely when its stick is transferred to another location, provided the destination forms a valid numeral or operator and the resulting equation contains only valid symbols.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When you need a vertical stick but the only source is an I, you may delete that I and use its stick elsewhere, as long as you do not leave an empty character.
matchstick.example: Assuming you cannot take the only stick from an I, thus missing the solution where that stick is transferred to create a new I after V (e.g., V = XVII - X → VI = XVI - X).

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model focuses on the visual matchstick move and neglects to check the numeric values of the resulting Roman numerals.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: After generating a candidate equation, convert all Roman numerals to Arabic numbers and confirm the equality before finalising the answer.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model removes a stick from an operator without ensuring the remaining sticks still form a recognized operator (+, -, =).
matchstick.how_to_avoid: After removing a stick from an operator, verify that the leftover shape matches a valid operator; if not, choose a different source stick.

matchstick.description: Removing the only stick from a numeral
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model treats the numeral as a container and removes its sole stick, leaving an empty, invalid character.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: If a numeral has only one stick, either keep it unchanged or transfer the stick to create a new valid numeral elsewhere, eliminating the source character entirely.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model forgets the strict output template required by the verifier.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Always end the response with the exact line 'Correct version of the equation: <equation>', using uppercase letters and collapsing whitespace.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model changes a symbol by removing a stick but does not place that stick on another symbol, effectively deleting a stick.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Pair every stick removal with a corresponding addition to another character, preserving the total stick count.
